technical.summary: Bullish structure with golden cross and new highs, but multiple overbought conditions and weak trend strength limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: SNPS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with 76 days to next report.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling; lack of news data and small trade sizes limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (347.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, imminent NFP event (1 day), and earnings 76 days out create hostile trading environment for SNPS.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with price above major MAs and new 20-day highs provide bullish structure, while extreme fear sentiment (12/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple overbought conditions (RSI 9/14, Stochastic, Williams %R), weak trend strength (ADX 22.41), VIX crisis (347.2), imminent NFP event, and zero fundamental/smart money support create hostile risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and price above major MAs provide bullish structure, and extreme fear sentiment (12/100) offers contrarian opportunity. decision.primary_risk: VIX in crisis territory (347.2) combined with imminent NFP event (1 day) and 76-day earnings proximity creates macro volatility that will likely trigger stop-loss before swing target is reached.
